svg.text: Forward at EP=4: every rank routes its own tokens, each expert gets its rows from all four
ragged routing, small preset (4 × 128 tokens), one MoE layer; band width ∝ rows; a stripe's number on an expert bar = the source rank
Before the dispatch: one all_to_all of the [EP, E_loc] counts plus one .tolist() gives every rank its ROW of this matrix (what it sends) and its COLUMN (what it receives).
